requirements.evidence: All contract items are present: pairing command with random zero-padded code, 10-min expiry, consumed reset, audit log and failure exit (`app/Console/Commands/TotemPairingCode.php:11-44`); auth 400/401 split, transaction + `lockForUpdate`, consumed marking, totem creation and entity pair in the response (`app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemAuthController.php:31-122`); HS256 token with all claims and config TTL (`TotemAuthController.php:61-70`, `app/Support/TotemJwt.php:21-66`, `config/services.php` hunk); totem.auth middleware with expiry/totem/preset/entity checks, heartbeat and live scope intersection (`app/Http/Middleware/TotemAuth.php:40-106`); the three endpoints with 403/404/422 handling and scope checks (`app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemController.php:24-141`); ticket issuance through `IssueTicket` with channel `totem` (`TotemController.php:91-96`); backend-owned priorities (`app/Support/TotemPriorities.php:17-47`); throttles and 429 rendering (`routes/api.php:7-12`, `bootstrap/app.php:35`); localhost CORS (204 preflight, no ACAO otherwise) via `config/cors.php:17-31` and `app/Http/Middleware/TotemCors.php:26-57`; `.env.example` + pinned test secret (`phpunit.xml:41-42`); docs updated (`docs/api/totem.md`, `docs/database-schema.md`, `docs/architecture.md`). Edge cases (expired/consumed/inactive/no-oracle, foreign entity slug, inactive queue, invalid priority, preset queue removal) are covered in `tests/Feature/TotemApiTest.php`.

conventions.evidence: Domain write reused via `App\Actions\IssueTicket` (`app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemController.php:91`); migrations use the make:migration stub shape and reversible `down()` (`database/migrations/2026_10_29_062438_create_totems_table.php:9-30`); `$fillable` set deliberately via `#[Fillable]` (`app/Models/Totem.php:11`, `app/Models/TotemPreset.php:11-19`); audit channel used per logging docs (`TotemAuthController.php:89,104`, command line 38); docs/CHANGELOG kept in sync; tests are Pest and present for every feature. Deviation: `app/Support/TotemJwt.php:99` declares a second class (`TotemJwtException`) in the same file, breaking PSR-4 one-class-per-file (and it only autoloads because `TotemJwt` is loaded first).

security.evidence: Every endpoint is behind `totem.auth`; missing/invalid/expired token, inactive totem/preset and entity mismatch all return 401 (`app/Http/Middleware/TotemAuth.php:55-99`); scope is recomputed as claim ∩ current preset join (`TotemAuth.php:100-106`); HS256 verification uses `hash_equals` plus an `alg` check (`app/Support/TotemJwt.php:60-66`); codes are regex-validated and failures are indistinguishable (`TotemAuthController.php:31-95`); the full code is never logged (`TotemAuthController.php:89`, `tests/Feature/TotemApiTest.php:420`); priority is whitelisted server-side and queues are resolved within the entity (`TotemController.php:86-141`); mass assignment constrained by `#[Fillable]`; CORS is explicit with `supports_credentials => false` and `hash_equals` for the extra origin (`config/cors.php:31`, `TotemCors.php:51-53`); secrets come from config and the test secret is pinned.

tests.evidence: Strong suite: pairing command and failure (`tests/Feature/TotemApiTest.php:22-45`), malformed codes (46), no-oracle failures (56), successful pairing + claims + single use (77), scope captured in JWT (111), pairing throttle (124), unauthenticated/forged tokens (136), deactivated totem/preset (149), expired token (167), last_seen_at (187), queues listing/order/entity mismatch (202), live scope removal (232), priorities and 404/403 cases (250), sequential issuance with channel (294), invalid priorities (323), inactive queue (341), CORS (356), ticket throttle (388), relations (409), no-code logging (420). Gaps: the claims-vs-totem-vs-preset entity-mismatch branch (`app/Http/Middleware/TotemAuth.php:97`) is never exercised, and the command's audit log/printed code and the pairing-success audit entry (`TotemAuthController.php:104`) are not asserted.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses `IssueTicket` (`TotemController.php:91`) and keeps the JWT dependency-free as the task permits (`app/Support/TotemJwt.php:1-102`); no speculative service/repository layer. Some duplication: the origin allow-list is expressed twice (`config/cors.php:21-23` regex/env list vs `app/Http/Middleware/TotemCors.php:51-53`), and `TotemPriorities::values()` (`app/Support/TotemPriorities.php:41`) is unused dead code.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods with docblocks and clear names throughout (`TotemAuthController.php`, `TotemAuth.php:29-106`, `TotemController.php:124-159`). Minor: `queuePayload` hides magic presentation values inline (`TotemController.php:155-159`), and the final test in `tests/Feature/TotemApiTest.php:420` starts immediately after the previous closing brace with no blank line, unlike the rest of the file; the two-classes-in-one-file layout (`TotemJwt.php:99`) also hurts navigability.

scope.evidence: Every file serves the totem task: models/factories/migrations, command, controllers, middleware, JWT/priorities support, routes, CORS config, env/phpunit, and the required docs/CHANGELOG updates; no unrelated refactors or files.

issues.explanation: `TotemJwtException` is declared in the same file as `TotemJwt`, violating PSR-4 one-class-per-file; it only resolves because `TotemJwt` happens to be autoloaded before the exception is referenced, so it should live in its own file.
The entity-mismatch branch between claims, totem and preset is a required 401 case but has no test, so a regression in that authorization check would go unnoticed.
The command test asserts the new code/expiry but not the printed code or the audit-log entry the task requires, and no test asserts the pairing-success audit entry.

`description` is only taken from `labels_i18n['description']` and `visual` is hardcoded (`#0055FF`, `ticket`), so the documented preset `appearance` never influences the queues payload and `description` may always be null; no test asserts either field.
`values()` is never referenced (the controller uses `find()`), so it is dead code.

The docs describe `totem-auth`/`totem-ticket` as dedicated limiters, but the routes use the positional `throttle:10,1,<prefix>` form (a cache-key prefix), not named `RateLimiter::for` limiters, so the documentation wording is inaccurate even though the limits are correct.
`totems.name` is nullable although the task lists `name` without a null option and every totem is created with a name.
The new `it('logs pairing failures...')` block starts with no blank line after the previous test, inconsistent with the file's formatting.

review.summary: The change implements the full totem BFF contract: pairing command, atomic code exchange with HS256 JWTs, the `totem.auth` middleware with live preset-scope intersection, the queues/priorities/ticket endpoints via `IssueTicket`, throttling and localhost CORS, plus docs and a broad Pest suite. It is well scoped and secure; the only notable issues are the second class in `TotemJwt.php` (PSR-4), a few untested failure paths (entity-mismatch claims, audit logging) and minor hardcoded/untested presentation fields, which are fixable nits rather than blockers.
